verdict.rationale: Shopify documents agent identification and trust tiers (Token, Signed, Anonymous). Rate limits scale by tier, Checkout is limited more strictly than Cart, and complete_checkout and Order MCP are Token-tier only. A hosted agent profile is required, and the runtime probe confirms requests without one are rejected. Capability negotiation is also "server-selects," so the business picks the active capability set. However, these controls are set by Shopify's platform tiers, not by the merchant; nothing shows a merchant setting per-agent rate limits or allow/deny lists. Missing for 10: merchant-configurable per-agent or per-platform allowlists and denylists, merchant-set rate limits, an admin UI or API for agent access policy, and independent corroboration of merchant control.
